# ListElementBase

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Base class for list elements (ordered and unordered) that provides common functionality for item spacing, indentation, and nested list handling. This reduces code duplication across list types and ensures consistent list rendering behavior.

Namespace `BonniePDF`. Extends `TextElementBase`.

- [`Indent`](#indent): Indentation for nested lists (in points)
- [`ItemSpacing`](#itemspacing): Spacing between list items (in points)
